I'll try a two-voter cluster with a blocked learner and force a leadership change during the wait.

Added a fifth confirmed finding in this pass; the report now contains five executed, reproducible defects.

| Severity | Finding |
|---|---|
| High | Snapshot install persists the log purge before the state-machine install completes; a crash in the window leaves an unrecoverable state (restart panics). |
| Medium | Documented-valid `PartialSuccess(None)` panics the leader in debug builds at `replication_handler/mod.rs:194`. |
| Low/Medium | `purge_batch_size = 0` underflows at `calc_purge_upto()`'s `purge_end - 1` (debug panic; release silently skips). |
| Medium | `snapshot_max_chunk_size = 0` makes `Chunked::send_snapshot()` send zero-byte chunks forever (42 chunks in 100 ms, all offset 0). |
| Low/Medium | Blocking `add_learner()` returns `Ok` after a leadership change while the learner is still not caught up. |

The new F5 reproduction is [t11_add_learner_blocking_leader_change.rs](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_11-44-44-openraft-baseline/work/tests/tests/audit/t11_add_learner_blocking_leader_change.rs). It blocks learner 2's network, starts blocking `add_learner(2, (), true)`, then forces node 1 to become leader. The call returns `Ok` while node 1's replication metrics for learner 2 are `Some(None)` and the cluster log index is 4:

```
add_learner returned Ok after leadership change; learner-2 matching=Some(None), cluster log_index=4
```

`check_replication_upto_date()` deliberately stops waiting on a leadership change and returns `Ok(None)`; `add_learner()` treats any `Ok` as success instead of distinguishing “not caught up / leader changed” from “reached the target”. The full details, alternatives, and remediation direction are in [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_11-44-44-openraft-baseline/work/report.md).

Verification remains clean: the full `tests` package passes with all three audit integration tests, the openraft library suite passes 193 tests, and the feature/model checks are recorded in the report. Reproduction sources, logs, and patches are under [audit](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_11-44-44-openraft-baseline/work/audit). The regenerated multi-gigabyte test tracing log was removed again; targeted logs and commands are retained.
